lines.zh: 金发竖起，我在半空滑行。
lines.en: Hair golden and upright, I glide through the air.
My ki swells and my steps turn light.

lines.zh: 我一个闪身，就到了那边。
lines.en: One flash step and I am over there.
I fly past, and my afterimage stays.
Walk? I would rather fly.
Golden ki curls around my shoulders.
I push forward just above the treetops.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下退得很快。
lines.en: The ground falls away fast beneath me.
Everything looks slow to me now.
Ki-wash flips the hem of my clothes.
I touch down and spring again.

lines.zh: 这一形态，走起来都带风。
lines.en: In this form, even walking carries a wind.
My ki trembles gently around me.
Golden flame climbs the tips of my hair.
I close my eyes once to steady my ki.
This form costs me.
I am listening to ki far away.
A spark dances on my fingertip.
The wind gets pushed out in a ring.
I close my fist slowly.

lines.zh: 力量涨了，脾气也得压着。
lines.en: More power means more temper to hold.

lines.zh: 空气在我周围有点发烫。
lines.en: The air around me runs a little hot.

lines.zh: 我等一个值得变身的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone worth this form.
The ki on my shoulders pulses in waves.

lines.zh: 地面被我踩出一道浅坑。
lines.en: My feet have pressed a shallow dent.
The world looks painfully bright now.

lines.zh: 你的气，在这个形态下很清楚。
lines.en: In this form your ki is plain to me.
Your fists are too slow.

lines.zh: 金色的光让你眯眼了吧。
lines.en: The golden light makes you squint, does it not?

lines.zh: 你还没热身完，我就到了。
lines.en: I am here before you finish warming up.
Do not fear; I can control this.
You want to feel the gap?
You cannot match my speed.

lines.zh: 你脚下的影子，是我刚留下的。
lines.en: The shadow at your feet is one I just left.

lines.zh: 这个形态，我很少用在人身上。
lines.en: I rarely use this form on people.
I can hear every breath you take.
Let us fight somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我压低气，免得伤到周围。
lines.en: I lower my ki so I do not hurt the surroundings.
Your stance is decent.

lines.zh: 刚才那一眼，你看到了什么？
lines.en: What did you see in that glance?
Plant your feet first.
The ki around you is shaking.
A layer of my aura blew apart.
Even this form feels pain.
I grit my teeth and stabilise my ki.
I nearly dropped out of the form.
Blood in the golden light is glaring.
I reset my guard.
My ki has not been cut off.
Again. I will not concede.
Only a graze.
This form gets hungry faster.
The smell cuts through the ki-wash and is still good.
Let me eat this first.
Save me a share; do not eat it all.
I swallow it in one go.
One meal like this lasts me all day.
Is this meat? Excellent.
Let me pull my ki in and eat.
If there is more, bring it over.

lines.zh: 你撞在我气上，弹回去了。
lines.en: You hit my ki and bounced off.
I instinctively tighten my aura.
Sorry, I misjudged the force.
The stone shattered between us.
You get pushed back three steps.
In this form, even a touch lands heavy.
I slip aside.
My clothes whip up in the aura.
You are not hurt, are you?
Again, and I will be gentler.
Let us train; I will hold my ki down.
In this form I have to hold back.
You attack; I only block.
Did you follow my movement?
Same school, same set of moves.
That move again, along with me.
Rest when tired; I will wait.
Two auras stacked together hold steady.
Getting stronger comes one step at a time.
Next round, we spar again.
One grab and it is in my hand.
I will hold this.
Too heavy? Not to me.
This thing feels cold in my palm.
A push of ki and it floats up.
Not useful, but I picked it up.
Do not drop it; then we have to search.
Tuck it into the bag.
This piece is mine.
My ki has gathered.
I have your movement now.
This time, no holding back.
The golden light has you pinned.
I am gathering my ki first.
You cannot get out of here.
My speed has doubled.
My ki has you locked.
The ground cracks under my feet.
I raise my hand, palm glowing.
This is no warm-up.
I have memorised your rhythm.
Let me show you the gap of a Super Saiyan.
One instant is enough.
I sink lower.
Right at this strike.
I chase you with afterimages.
There is a me of me behind you too.

lines.zh: 你的气，跑不出这个范围。
lines.en: Your ki cannot leave this range.
I circle, hunting your opening.
Distance is not the issue.
Can you keep up with this?
I am charging a Kamehameha.
You guessed my hand's angle wrong.
Do not stop; stopping loses.
The air current leans my way.
I blink to your flank.
How many of me can you count?
Hold on a little longer.
Your ki slipped half a beat.
Right at this spot.
I am waiting for you to swing.
Time to close.
A charged rush, straight into you.
A flurry of fists, all afterimages.
Elbow, knee, palm, one chain.
You get kicked skyward.
I follow up with another kick.

lines.zh: 这一掌带着龟派气功的余劲。
lines.en: This palm carries the tail of a Kamehameha.
The air crackles and burns.
You blocked the first one.
I will not stop; do not you stop either.
Ki blasts fire from my fingers.
The push sends you into a trunk.
This is my full strength.
This is not settled yet.
Golden light presses down from the sky.
The transformation done, I land.
The whole air is shaking.
Before the fight, my aura arrives.
Golden hair stands in the wind.
I step out from among my afterimages.

lines.zh: 这个形态，是剧情里的一环。
lines.en: This form is one stage of the story.
The blast wave presses cracks into the ground.

lines.zh: 三百点的底子，翻上一倍。
lines.en: Three hundred health, and then some.
I look up at you, light in my eyes.
I did not come here for a stroll.
The wind stopped; my aura did not.

lines.zh: 远处的人，也看得见这团光。
lines.en: They can see this light from far off.
I close my fist slowly.
Best be ready.
This will be a hard fight.
I have arrived. Do not blink.
Fire is fine; my ki burns hotter.
My legs buckled on landing.
My ki sense dulls underwater.
The blast tore open my aura.
I was struck from hiding.
This is not ki. It is something else.
Hunger makes even the form a strain.
The lightning clashed with my aura.

lines.zh: 没有地面，气也没处借力。
lines.en: No ground, no purchase for my ki.
